To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the proton optical model potential parameters obtained in the present work exhibit an energy and mass dependence, (2) a global set of optical model potential parameters has been obtained for medium weight nuclei by combining the low energy data with the high energy data, and (3) the global set of optical parameters obtained in the energy region 4 to 180 MeV is in agreement with the optical model parameters obtained in the intermediate and high energy regions.
we have obtained a "global" proton optical model potential for medium weight nuclei, in the proton energy domain from 4 to 180 MeV by combining our results with those of other researchers.
The real part of the proton optical potential exhibits a large energy dependence at energies below 4 MeV.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a systematic study of the proton optical potential for medium weight nuclei at sub-Couloumb energies.
the development of a global proton optical model at low and intermediate energies for medium weight target nuclei.
the study of the optical model parameters for protons in the energy range between 1 and 180 Me V.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proton optical model is a useful tool for the analysis of proton scattering data at low and intermediate energies.
the present optical model analysis of proton elastic scattering data at energies below 10 MeV for medium weight nuclei has been carried out for the first time.
the present analysis is a significant contribution to the proton optical model in medium weight nuclei at sub-Coulumb energies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the optical model parameters obtained in the present work for the proton energies between 4 and \ensuremath{\le} 60 MeV are found to be in good agreement with those reported in the literature for the same energy region.
a global set of optical parameters has been obtained in the present work in the proton energy region 4-180 MeV for the medium weight nuclei.
the proton optical potential parameters are not well defined at low energies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proton optical model potential parameters are not universal, and the proton optical model calculations should be performed with the appropriate set of parameters.
